claims.assertion: Yazhi says regressive entities harvest human and animal suffering and souls, seeking to return the dead to physical lives for further exploitation; she locates most activity in the UK.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Her account of current events and afterlife.

claims.assertion: She says awakened souls can refuse or escape through higher frequency; otherwise they may be trapped in low-astral realms shaped by their worst fears.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says few people are prepared to resist.

claims.assertion: Yazhi distinguishes consent at higher planes from the nonconsensual suffering and atrocity experienced by embodied humans.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
